name: The Ordinary AHA 30% + BHA 2% Peeling Solution, Advanced Exfoliating Peel for Brighter Skin, 1 Fl Oz
description: AHA 30% + BHA 2% Peeling Solution is an exfoliating facial designed to improve the appearance of skin texture, prevent pore congestion and target uneven skin tone. This high-strength exfoliating serum combines 5 exfoliating acids, at a total of 32%, to offer high-strength exfoliation both on skin’s surface and within pores. It also features Hyaluronic Acid, Pro-Vitamin B5, Black Carrot Extract and Tasmanian Pepperberry (a known anti-irritant). When compared to a professional acid peel*, AHA 30% + BHA 2% Peeling Solution offers comparable results while respecting the skin's’ barrier and without the downtime.
